_README: Schema for a table design manifest, read by `python3 tools/table_art.py build tables/designs/<name>.json`.
Copy this file to <name>.json and fill it in. Every number comes from tables/anchors.json.
The build prints a table of unit / final size / interior / target / status and exits non-zero on any MISMATCH.
A unit whose open interior is not exactly `rect` within 2 px is a MISMATCH - that check is the whole point.
raw files are generator output in assets/tables/<design>/raw/<file>.png; final/ and preview/ are derived.

units._note: a casing around a group of rects. rect = the interior = the game's rect; border = (L, T, R, B) drawn OUTSIDE it.
units._budget: must not exceed the free space in anchors.json -> free_space, on any side

rails._note: an internal seam, cut from a unit's own bottom rail. Drawn AFTER the units, or the casing covers it.

cards._note: a bezel drawn INSIDE the card rect, one file per card size. kind: field | hand | cpu

decor._note: art that is not a frame: edge brackets, ornaments. box = [x, y, w, h] on the canvas.
